quote: One of the hallmarks of ego is defensiveness. It means that we stand guard at the gates of self, patrolling visitors, VIPs, intruders, everything. This is a very fragile way of living. That means that at any time, any person, anywhere, can do something destructive to my own inner environment. The move away from some of that defensiveness into a certain kind of acceptance, love, deeper understanding, is very important as we evolve ethically.
author: Matthew Brensilver
